biography:
As Director of EMEA Data Centre Strategy at Amazon Web Services (AWS), I oversee infrastructure strategic planning and delivery across the region. My work emphasizes strategic alignment with market trends, customer needs, and AWS's growth objectives, leveraging expertise in strategic planning, contract negotiation, and multi-stakeholder collaboration. Key contributions include managing cross-functional teams to ensure the timely delivery of critical data center infrastructure. During my leadership of AWS's Data Center Supply Strategy, Site Selection and Acquisition, I have developed innovative solutions to meet the growing demand for cloud services.

I have lead high-performing teams in delivering large-scale, mission-critical data center infrastructure with a focus on speed, quality, and innovation. With a background in construction delivery, commissioning, and technical program management, I bring deep expertise in managing complex projects from planning through execution across global markets.

In my previous roles I drove the strategic vision for data center build and fit outs, aligning infrastructure initiatives with broader organizational objectives. I lead cross-functional teams of project managers, engineers, and construction professionals, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

My responsibilities have spanned the full lifecycle of infrastructure delivery—developing strategic roadmaps, optimizing cost and efficiency, managing vendor performance, and ensuring regulatory compliance. I work closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to deliver scalable, future-ready facilities that meet the highest standards of performance, sustainability, and reliability.

I’m passionate about using data to drive decisions and continuously improve execution. Whether through value stream mapping, risk mitigation planning. I focus on delivering results that support business growth and operational excellence.

I have led construction delivery, including timelines, budgets, and substantial completion. Through managing construction teams and coordinating with colocation providers I managed risks and compliance throughout the construction phase. 

With a strong foundation in both strategy and execution, I thrive in dynamic environments where infrastructure is critical to business success. I’m always looking for opportunities to build better, faster, and smarter—and to lead teams that are excited to push the boundaries of what’s possible in data center construction.
Gary Halpin MSc is a distinguished EMEA Region Director for Data Center Strategy and Site Acquisition at Amazon Web Services (AWS). With a robust background in data center construction and infrastructure, Gary leads a specialized team of Data Center Supply Strategists across the EMEA region, focusing on the acquisition of large-scale greenfield and brownfield sites, as well as colocation data centers. His expertise in business planning and strategy enables him to navigate complex negotiations and secure optimal locations that align with AWS's commitment to delivering exceptional customer-centric services.

In his current role, Gary is responsible for implementing end-to-end Data Center Supply Solutions, ensuring that AWS can meet the growing demand for cloud services while maintaining high standards of sustainability and efficiency. His strategic vision encompasses not only the physical aspects of data center acquisition but also the integration of cutting-edge technologies and innovative practices that enhance operational capabilities. Key projects under his leadership include the development of state-of-the-art facilities that leverage renewable energy sources, thereby contributing to AWS's sustainability goals.

Gary's leadership style fosters collaboration and innovation within his team, empowering them to tackle challenges in the fast-paced data center industry. His ability to blend technical knowledge with strategic foresight, positions AWS as a leader in the market, ensuring that the company remains at the forefront of data center solutions. With a focus on building resilient infrastructures that support the ever-evolving digital landscape, Gary Halpin is instrumental in shaping the future of cloud computing at AWS.
